messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 Pager: ALERT from OrchardCorp (customer-id: orchard-93). Observed increased websocket disconnects (524/timeouts) and HTTP streaming retries from their app gateway to our enterprise VPC gateway in us-east-1. Affected: dedicated pool orchard-vpc-1. Potential customer impact: chat sessions dropping, streaming completions failing, retry storms. Please acknowledge and coordinate. Incident channel: #incidents. runbook: https://runbooks.internal/streaming-timeouts

alice_oncall: Acked. I'm on it. Landing to triage — will grab logs and check dedicated pool health first. @derek_infra can you confirm node-level network metrics for orchard-vpc-1?

bob_sre: grabbing logs now. Seeing repeated: `ws: close 1006` and upstream 524 gateway timeouts. Sample from edge logs:```
[2026-03-15T14:02:11Z] orchard-vpc-1 node-7 stream_conn: upstream read timeout after 30s, client-retry=3
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] orchard-vpc-1 node-5 kvcache: miss, falling back to model-host-2
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] orchard-vpc-1 node-5 streaming: backpressure: inflight=64, soft-limit=60
```
Looks like backpressure + upstream timeout triggers.

derek_infra: Confirmed spikes in TCP retransmits on node-5/7 and elevated CPU on node-5 (worker threads saturated). Network perf on NIC looks normal at host level, but socket queues are filling. I suspect a thundering herd from aggressive client retries + our continuous batching causing large inflight windows.

alice_oncall: Good context. Initial mitigation options: 1) Short-term: apply connection-level pacing on orchard-vpc-1 (reduce max inflight to 40), bump upstream timeout to 60s for this pool, and temporarily disable streaming upgrade for OrchardCorp (force SDK to fallback to polling). 2) Mid-term: route OrchardCorp traffic to a reserved fallback hostpool (shared-hosted-2) that has headroom. Which do we prefer for fastest customer relief?

carla_am: Customer-facing note: OrchardOps is reporting chat sessions reconnecting frequently. I'll coordinate the support ticket and draft a message for OrchardCorp. We need to give them a 15–30 min ETA for a mitigation. Please confirm which mitigation we choose so I can communicate.

orchard_ops: OrchardCorp engineering here — we are seeing multiple users losing streaming context. Polling is acceptable as fallback but it increases latency; prefer a graceful switch if possible. We can flip client retry to exponential backoff if you need more time.

bob_sre: Can do pacing + bump timeout immediately via runtime flags. Command to apply (prod orchestrator):
```bash
rwctl pools update orchard-vpc-1 --set runtime.max_inflight=40 --set runtime.upstream_timeout_sec=60
```
I'll push that to a single AZ first (node-5) as a canary. If stable for 2mins, we roll. Also plan: enable request tagging so we can track OrchardCorp requests end-to-end: `X-Org-ID: orchard-93`.

derek_infra: Agreed. I'll prepare quick traffic-shift plan to shared-hosted-2 if needed. Steps: 1) add temporary routing entry in smart-router: `if org==orchard-93 then prefer shared-hosted-2` 2) ensure shared-hosted-2 has quantization/profile compatible model variant.

alice_oncall: Executing bob's change on node-5 now. Monitoring logs and stream health.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: Started job 48532 to apply runtime flags to orchard-vpc-1/node-5. Job link: https://deploys.internal/jobs/48532

bob_sre: node-5 change applied. Early signals: inflight down to ~38, socket queue length reduced. No new 524 from node-5 in last 45s. Node-7 still noisy.

alice_oncall: Rolling change to node-7 now and then we'll assess for broader roll.

orchard_ops: Confirming client telemetry — streaming success rate on orchard clients in us-east-1 improved on a subset of users (~30%) after your change. Thank you.

carla_am: Draft customer message: "We're seeing elevated streaming disconnects due to retry/backpressure interaction. We've applied a temporary pacing and timeout bump to your VPC gateway and are monitoring. If you prefer, we can shift traffic to a fallback cluster to fully avoid streaming for the next ~1 hour. Which would you prefer?"

alice_oncall: node-7 change done. Monitoring full pool. Thundering herd symptoms reduced. 5min ago aggregate streaming success is up from 68% -> 94% for observed sessions.

derek_infra: Given improvement, hold off on traffic-shift. I'll keep shared-hosted-2 warm but not flip yet. Need a postmortem to look at client retry behavior and our batching heuristics.

bob_sre: Logging preserved and tagged. Taking snapshot for post-incident analysis: `s3://prod-logs/incidents/3280007777/`

incident-bot: triage-bot: Severity: sev2 -> customer-visible degradation. Paging cleared as mitigations are in place.

alice_oncall: I'll own the follow-up: create a short postmortem, include runbook gaps (no automatic inflight backpressure cap per pool, no org-specific retry guidance). Action items: (A) Add per-tenant soft inflight cap in runtime (assigned to eng-runtime). (B) Update onboarding docs for enterprise customers to recommend client exponential backoff and streaming retry limits (assigned to devex). (C) Add a circuit-breaker to route to polling fallback automatically if upstream timeouts exceed threshold (eng-platform).

carla_am: Sending the customer note now. I'll update ticket with mitigation timestamps and next steps.

orchard_ops: Thanks team — OrchardCorp confirms drop rate improved significantly. We'll resume normal client config but hold off aggressive retries for 24h. Please keep us posted on the postmortem.

alice_oncall: Closing live mitigation. If anything recurs, reopen and we'll escalate to dedicated pool resharding. Closing thread in 1h once postmortem skeleton is posted.

bob_sre: Postmortem skeleton: `https://pm.internal/3280007777-orchardcorp` — I've added logs and initial timeline.

incident-bot: Incident resolved for now. Recorded mitigation: applied runtime.inflight cap=40, upstream_timeout=60s for orchard-vpc-1; no traffic-shift required.

alice_oncall: Final note: Customer impact window: 2026-03-15T14:01:40Z -> 2026-03-15T14:15:10Z. Estimated affected sessions: ~1.2k. Will follow up with RCA and remediation plan. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
